newsitem.title: CHINA: China Everbright unit wins forex approval.
newsitem.headline: China Everbright unit wins forex approval.

text.p: Everbright Securities Ltd, a subsidiary of the China Everbright (Group) Corp, said on Monday it had won regulatory approval to conduct foreign exchange-related business.

The State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) granted the company permission to offer services related to foreign currency B shares of domestic firms and H shares or stock of Chinese companies listed in Hong Kong, said an official of Everbright Securities.
The company would be able to trade and underwrite such share offers and would undertake foreign exchange investment and guarantees for a period of three years.
"We are contacting enterprises planning to list B shares," the official said. She gave no further details.
